items.title: 共庆30周年：MachineGames携手id Software推出《Quake》新章节
items.summary: 为了纪念定义第一人称射击游戏的经典作品《Quake》走过辉煌三十载，屡获殊荣的MachineGames携手id Software，再度带来全新的章节。目前，“Dawn of the Machine”已作为《Quake》免费更新推出。 据悉，本次更新收录19张全新地图，串联成一场紧密衔接的完整战役，同时加入隐藏秘密、伴随玩家踏上旅程的全新配乐、以及一张可与好友、敌人和机器人展开激烈对战的全新死亡竞赛地图。噩梦只是幻象，机器才是现实 玩家将化身身经百战的Ranger，在一个迷宫般的维度中求生。这里的时间不断折返，形成独特的循环结构，每一次对当下的探索都会改变未来的走向。收集符文以开启过去无法通行的

ja.title: 30 周年を祝う: MachineGames と id Software が「Quake」の新章を開始
ja.summary: 一人称視点シューティングゲームを定義した古典的な作品「Quake」の 30 年の歴史を記念して、受賞歴のある MachineGames と id Software が再び新しい章をもたらします。 Dawn of the Machine は現在、Quake の無料アップデートとして利用可能です。このアップデートには 19 の新しいマップが含まれており、それらは完全で緊密に接続されたキャンペーンに接続されていると報告されています。また、隠された秘密、プレイヤーの旅に同行する新しいサウンドトラック、友人、敵、ロボットとの激しい戦闘のための新しいデスマッチ マップも追加されます。悪夢は単なる幻想であり、機械は現実です。プレイヤーは、迷路のような空間で生き残るために、百戦錬磨のレンジャーに変身します。ここでは時間は循環し続け、独特の循環構造を形成しています。現在を探求するたびに、未来の方向性が変わります。ルーンを集めて、以前はアクセスできなかったロックを解除します

en.title: Celebrating 30th Anniversary: ​​MachineGames and id Software launch a new chapter of "Quake"
en.summary: To commemorate the 30-year history of the classic work "Quake" that defined first-person shooters, the award-winning MachineGames and id Software once again bring a new chapter. Dawn of the Machine is currently available as a free update for Quake. It is reported that this update includes 19 new maps, which are connected into a complete and tightly connected campaign. It also adds hidden secrets, a new soundtrack that accompanies players on their journey, and a new deathmatch map for fierce battles with friends, enemies, and robots. Nightmares are just illusions, machines are reality. Players will transform into a battle-hardened Ranger to survive in a maze-like dimension. Time here keeps turning back and forth, forming a unique cyclic structure. Every exploration of the present will change the direction of the future. Collect runes to unlock previously inaccessible

en.summary: In this episode, RED and Shiyang continue to share their experiences and feelings about "Dragon Among Us 4: Successor of Legends". (Picture/Ronaldo) I can’t be called a loyal player of business simulation games, but there are usually a lot of plants planted in such games. Generally speaking, the gameplay in simulation management and plant-related games is to plant vegetables, flowers, and trees, water them on time, and wait a few days, and a batch of neat things will grow in the ground. In reality, I also like plants. But I don’t like planting flowers that much. This is because I can’t stand a plant that doesn’t grow well for more than half a year, just to wait for a short flowering period. In comparison, buying fresh cut flowers is much easier. I also prefer to spend dozens of dollars to buy a few bunches of peonies, put them in a vase, and watch them bloom into their most beautiful flowers within a few days, and then throw them away. Water lilies are also beautiful, but none of the water lilies I bought in recent times have bloomed. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but fresh cut flowers always give me a sense of joy.
